test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

Based on the above, how is H related to L if ‘H + I – J × K + L’?
solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61a608ba368a2f04714d93fbc05cf8003fe895f71c49a7d08bac913c6ac0fe96.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother 
 Father
 Daughter 
 
 

 

Given: H + I – J × K + L

It means: H is the mother of I, I is the father of J, J is the daughter of K and K is the mother of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3bd40e1d4a4674345289fe8cc3eaa1fd2dddf2fcffbf65346a13a0e41bc08a6.png] 

So, H is the '**Father’s mother**' of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
